preferredThemeStyle.description: Desired visual direction or brand adjectives.

coreFeatures.description: Core user-facing features to include in the MVP.

targetAudience.description: Primary audience or buyer segment for the product.

themePreference.description: Desired MantleKit theme style or brand direction.

authRequired.description: Whether users need accounts, login, or protected areas.

commercialUse.description: Whether this is for client delivery or commercial agency use.
